edge_explainer: Cap structure verified FIRST per doctrine: preferred 40,000,000 authorised with ZERO issued, no pre-funded warrants, no converts, no debt; 17,105,643 common (ties exactly to 171M Avidity shares at the 1:10 ratio). Adjusted net cash = $267.8M cash + $15.0M BMS receivable - $12.6M true cash-claim liabilities = $270.3M, matching the launch PR's 'approximately $270 million' exactly. THE KEY ADJUSTMENT: $45.7M of the $58.3M total liabilities is DEFERRED REVENUE - a performance obligation settled by doing R&D, not a cash claim - so a naive net-cash screen understates net cash by ~$46M. Market cap $193.8M = ~0.78x net cash: the market ascribes roughly NEGATIVE $50M to two Ph1-ready siRNA-AOC assets plus live BMS and Lilly collaborations. Decline cause is pure uncovered-orphan drift, not derailment: zero negative 8-Ks, zero sell-side coverage, volume decayed from 3.96M day-1 shares to 38,938 on 08-03. Most informative single fact: the 2026-07-14 IND clearance (delivered on/ahead of the '2H26' guide) produced NO rally - the stock fell through it. This market is not pricing news at all. Only name in the batch with a favourable path check: 1.8% off an all-time low set one session ago, so there is no bounce to be late to. THE HONEST BEAR: below-cash biotechs convert cash into sunk R&D at ~$25M/qtr; ultra-rare indications; no catalyst inside 12 months; zero coverage means no re-rating mechanism. Cheapness without a transmission channel is a wait, not an edge.
